title: Preflight annual national NASA POWER Regional acquisition

acceptance.text: Exactly one national-area PRECTOTCORR request for calendar year 2001 is preserved and validated for size, timing, coordinates, dates, metadata, missingness, sampling-point extent coverage and checksum-aware cached resume without selecting district extraction.
acceptance.evidence: Executed exactly one national-area PRECTOTCORR JSON request for 2001. The 823,232-byte response completed in 2.865375 seconds with 140 unique output coordinates, 365 ordered dates at every location, 51,100 values, expected mm/day and LST metadata, zero fill/negative/non-finite values, and all 64 registry points inside the returned coordinate extent. Cached validation passed with network forbidden; six regional tests and all 76 repository tests passed.
